logs.text: I pounded a glass of glitter that my classmate, Dragoljub Lazic, dared me to drink, then got sent to the nurse's office.
My half sister, Inka, started primary school.
I was crowned ruler of the balance beam at recess.

scenarios.Title: Behavior
scenarios.Body:
Your vizsla, Hazel, just ate your fruit snacks.

What will you do?

logs.text: My vizsla, Hazel, ate my fruit snacks. I rewarded her with a Porterhouse steak.

scenarios.Title: Isn't she cute?
scenarios.Body: You rewarded your vizsla, Hazel, with a Porterhouse steak.

logs.text: I've been wondering what it would be like to live in the wealthiest part of Helsinki when I'm grown up.

scenarios.Title: Death
scenarios.Body:
The family vizsla, Hazel, died at the age of 15.

She perished after losing her last fight, against old age.

logs.text: My vizsla, Hazel, perished after losing her last fight, against old age.
My mother has been promoted to General Manager.

scenarios.Title: Quality Time
scenarios.Body:
Your mother wants to take you to play bingo at the community center.

Will you go with her?

logs.text: I went to play bingo at the community center with my mother.

scenarios.Title: Good times
scenarios.Body: You went to play bingo at the community center with your mother.

logs.text: My mother and my stepfather had a baby girl named Sanna Tuominen, my new half sister. She was a planned pregnancy.

scenarios.Title: Baby
scenarios.Body: Your mother and stepfather just had a baby girl named Sanna, your new half sister.

scenarios.Title: Freelance Gig
scenarios.Body:

What will you do?
